//: TYPE-CHECKING ONLY. This config never emits and is not part of the build — `vite build`
does not read it. `npm run typecheck` is the only consumer.
NO .ts/.tsx FILES. tailwind.config.js globs ./src/**/*.{js,jsx}; a .tsx file is invisible
to that glob, so its class names never reach the CSS and the component renders UNSTYLED
with a clean, exit-0 build. Types are JSDoc. See src/lib/types.js.
WHY checkJs IS false: it is an OPT-IN gate. src/VisualTaskCommandCenter.jsx is ~6.5k
untyped lines; switching checkJs on globally would emit hundreds of errors on day one and
the gate would be ignored within a week — the failure mode this safety net exists to
prevent. Instead each file opts in with `// @ts-check` at the top once it is typed, so the
checked set only ever grows and `npm run typecheck` is always expected to be CLEAN.
PHASE B RATCHET: every module extracted from the monolith gets `// @ts-check` as it lands.
Coverage therefore tightens automatically as the refactor proceeds, with no flag day.
